notablePrerequisites:
Hulking Metamorph is a copy of Kiora's Follower.
Kiora's Follower and Hulking Metamorph do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it.
When Kiora's Follower becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Kiora's Follower's ability from step 1, untapping Hulking Metamorph.
Activate Hulking Metamorph by tapping it.
When Hulking Metamorph becomes tapped, Judge of Currents triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve Hulking Metamorph's ability from step 4, untapping Kiora's Follower.
Repeat.
